title: Codewars 7kyu: Highest and Lowest
description: In this little assignment you are given a string of space separated numbers, and have to return the highest and lowest number as a space-separated string (e.g., 'max min').
constraints:
Valid space separated integers string
• Time: O(N) | Space: O(N)
explanation: Extracts integers from tokens and returns formatted string of max and min in O(N) time.
